name: Rare UI · Folder component

title.zh: Rare UI · 适合需要带交互动画的 Rea

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Rare UI 是一个动画 React 组件注册库，首页列出 Folder component、Duration Picker、Fluid Orb、Gravity Letters、OTP Input 等 28+ 个组件，并给出 shadcn CLI 安装命令。组件页可按 Display、AI Kit、Navigation、Inputs 等分组浏览，每个组件以单文件形式提供，可通过 shadcn CLI 或 MCP 添加。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Rare UI (https://www.rareui.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, motion, shadcn-ui.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
